summary: Sterope is one of the Pleiades, a daughter of Atlas. Apollodorus names her as the wife of Oenomaus; Hyginus also calls Oenomaus the son of Ares and Asterope daughter of Atlas.

sections.heading: Mythology
paragraphs: Apollodorus lists Sterope among the Pleiades and says she was married to Oenomaus (Bibliotheca 3.10.1).
Hyginus makes Oenomaus the son of Mars and Asterope daughter of Atlas (Fabulae 84); Pausanias shows Sterope as Oenomaus' wife on the Pelops pediment (Description of Greece 6.21.7).
